reading: The sketch mocks up a VS Code-style IDE screen: a left activity icon bar, an Explorer file-tree panel, a tabbed code editor with syntax-highlighted lines, a striped scrollbar/minimap strip, a bottom panel with Problems/Output/Terminal/Debug tabs and a test-run log, and a status bar at the very bottom. Typed notes give exact copy, colours and layout for every part, and one note sets the whole page to a near-black theme with light grey Helvetica text.
